name: Koujo Kanraku ~Kouki na Otome wa Mezamenai Jokumu o Miru ka?~
original_name: 皇女姦落 ～高貴な乙女は目覚めない辱夢を見るか？～
source:
Meet Alyssa Romania, the high princess of Provenia.
She's a beautiful girl with total virtue, raised as a delicate flower.
Suddenly her elder brother, the prince, dies of illness.

To reinforce the kingdom's stability, Alyssa is wedded to prince Kyle of Gothalia.
On the day of the ceremony...

Alyssa and her lady attendant Tanya prepare for marriage.
Suddenly, armed forces seize the nation in a coup.
Alyssa and Tanya are both captured! This shocking ambush
is spearheaded by a strange masked man.
He has taken the girls as his spoils of war... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE079520.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
阿莉莎·罗马尼亚是普罗维尼亚王国尊贵的皇女。她品行无瑕、容貌美丽，如温室花朵般受到悉心呵护。然而，身为王子的兄长突然因病去世。

为了巩固王国局势，阿莉莎将嫁给戈塔利亚王国的凯尔王子。婚礼当天……

阿莉莎与侍女塔妮娅正在为成婚作准备，武装势力却突然发动政变，夺取了整个国家。两名少女双双被俘！策划这场惊人突袭的是一个戴着奇怪面具的男人，而阿莉莎与塔妮娅已经成了他的战利品……
